title: A read block equals a word of matching length
statement: Let $\tau:\mathbb N\to\{0,1\}$, let $i,w\in\mathbb N$, and let $\beta$ be a finite bit string of length $w$. If $\tau(i+j)$ equals the $j$th bit of $\beta$ for every $0\le j<w$, then the block of $w$ bits read from position $i$ in $\tau$ is $\beta$.
hypotheses_covered: $\beta$ is a finite bit string with $|\beta|=w$.
For every $0\le j<w$, $\tau(i+j)$ equals the $j$th bit of $\beta$.
